help:
Progress bot commands:
/adduser <telegram_id> [name] — monitor a user and optionally set their display name
/removeuser <telegram_id> — stop monitoring a user
/users — list monitored users
/target <non-negative integer> — set today’s target
/target — show today’s target
/status — send a current summary
no_change: No change: {label} was already in that state.
internal_error: ⚠ Internal bot error; it was logged and the bot will continue processing updates.
summary_location_no_target: Location: {location}; today’s target is not set.
summary_conflict: ⚠ Conflicting current location totals: {conflicts}. Latest value is used.
alert_orphan_correction: Ignored orphan correction from {user}: no report exists for {day}.
alert_conflicting_totals: Conflicting current location totals: {details}. Using latest report value {location}.
